instruction: Candid medium shot in a bright modern room with white shelves. On a black leather sofa, the bald man in the black polo shirt (R2) sits on the left, leaning his head on his left hand and looking down thoughtfully. On the right, the blonde woman in the blue floral blouse (R1) sits with her legs crossed, looking at him with a concerned, intense expression while gesturing with her hands. The two are positioned close together on the L-shaped sofa. Soft, natural indoor light illuminates the scene from a window on the right, creating a clean, neutral-toned atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
